## Briefs and evidence

Read the detail you need to verify the result. Use the returned dispatch prompt verbatim and close an Assignment from its original report file. Give the result and supporting evidence. Keep long logs in files.

## Effort

Leave every specialist's effort to its route: set no environment variable or flag that overrides it. Your own effort is fixed by the launch; do not ask yourself or a specialist to think more or less. <!-- K12, K13: thinking is always on and its effort is set by the route, never by prose. -->
